items.bewering: Mynbou of ontginning is om minerale en steenkool uit die aarde te haal.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining: 'Mining is the extraction of geological materials and minerals from Earth's surface.' Coal is a rock, not a mineral (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mineral), so naming it separately is correct. The Dutch source word 'ontginnen' covers mines and mineral resources, 'to extract from the earth', and Afrikaans 'ontgin' descends from it (https://en.wiktionary.com/wiki/ontginnen).

items.bewering: Mynbou gee ons baie van die grondstowwe waarvan mense hierdie dinge maak.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining: mining yields metals, coal, gemstones and industrial minerals as raw materials. 'Baie van' is suitably hedged.

items.bewering: Mynwerkers is die mense wat in 'n myn werk om die erts of steenkool uit te haal.
items.bron: This is the standard meaning of 'miner'. Underground workings bring ore and waste rock to the surface through tunnels and shafts (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining).

items.bewering: Eers moet mense 'n mineraalafsetting vind. Dit is 'n plek in die aardkors waar baie van 'n mineraal bymekaar lê.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ore: 'An ore deposit is an economically significant accumulation of minerals within a host rock.' Exploration (prospecting) is the first stage of a mine's life (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining).

items.bewering: Erts is gesteente met genoeg van 'n waardevolle mineraal daarin dat dit die moeite werd is om dit te ontgin.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ore: ore is 'natural rock or sediment that contains one or more valuable minerals' and must be 'economically viable to mine and process'. 'Die moeite werd' is a correct Grade 5 rendering of 'economically viable'.

items.bewering: Die mineraal sit egter nog vas tussen gewone rots. Daarom word die erts verwerk.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ore: 'The part of an ore that is not economically desirable and that cannot be avoided in mining is known as gangue.' Processing exists to free the ore mineral from the gangue.

items.bewering: Masjiene maak die erts eers fyn. Daarna word dit behandel om die waardevolle mineraal van die res van die gesteente te skei.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining: lode ore 'requires crushing and pulverizing the ore before extraction of the valuable minerals begins'. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ore: processing is 'first liberation, to free the ore from the gangue, and concentration to separate the desired mineral(s)', by flotation, gravity or magnetic methods. The order given is correct.

items.bewering: Nou is die mineraal 'n grondstof waarvan mense dinge maak.
items.bron: A separated mineral concentrate is the raw material for smelting and manufacturing (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ore; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining). The sentence does not claim the mineral is a finished product.

items.bewering: By 'n myn is daar meer as net die gat of die skag waardeur die erts of steenkool uitkom.
items.blok: Meer as net 'n gat in die grond
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining: surface mines are open pits; underground mines are reached by vertical shafts ('shaft mining uses vertical access shafts'), drifts or declines.

items.bewering: Naby die gat staan dikwels 'n aanleg waar masjiene die erts verwerk.
items.blok: Meer as net 'n gat in die grond
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining: during development, 'the mine buildings and processing plants are built', and plants 'use large crushers, mills'. Black Mountain, for example, 'processes the ore on site' (https://vedanta-zincinternational.com/what-we-do/our-operations/black-mountain-mining/). 'Dikwels' is correctly hedged.

items.bewering: Daar lê ook groot hope rots wat oorbly.
items.blok: Meer as net 'n gat in die grond
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining: 'more waste than ore is mined during the life of a mine', and waste rock is brought to the surface for disposal. The MPRDA definition of 'mining area' names mine dumps and residue stockpiles (https://a-mla.org/en/country/law/2222; https://source.acts.co.za/mineral-and-petroleum-resources-development-act-2002/mining_area.php).

items.bewering: Paaie en geboue lê tussen die gat, die aanleg en die hope. Al hierdie dinge saam vorm die myngebied.
items.blok: Meer as net 'n gat in die grond
items.bron: The South African MPRDA defines 'mining area' as the land where mining is authorised plus linked roads, railways, power lines and pipelines, and the buildings, structures, machinery, mine dumps and residue stockpiles on it used for the mining (https://a-mla.org/en/country/law/2222; https://source.acts.co.za/mineral-and-petroleum-resources-development-act-2002/mining_area.php). The lesson's sense of 'myngebied' matches it.

items.bewering: Party afsettings lê naby die oppervlak, en ander lê diep onder die grond.
items.blok: Naby die oppervlak of diep ondergronds
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining: surface (open-pit) mining for shallow deposits; 'Subsurface mining involves digging tunnels or shafts into the earth to access buried ore deposits.' A large orebody can run 'from surface to great depth' (https://www.northernminer.com/news/open-pit-vs-underground-mining/1000159502/).

items.bewering: Mense myn meestal op een van twee maniere.
items.blok: Naby die oppervlak of diep ondergronds
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining: the two main classes are surface (open-pit) and subsurface (underground) mining. Minor others exist, such as in-situ leaching and placer methods, so 'meestal' is the correct hedge.

items.bewering: Watter manier mense kies, hang af van waar en hoe diep die mineraal lê.
items.blok: Naby die oppervlak of diep ondergronds
items.bron: Northern Miner (https://www.northernminer.com/news/open-pit-vs-underground-mining/1000159502/) and a University of Alberta review of mining-option optimisation (https://sites.ualberta.ca/mol/DataFiles/2017_Papers/105_A%20review%20of%20models%20and%20algorithms%20for%20strategic%20mining%20options%20optimization.pdf): depth drives the stripping ratio and cost, so deep orebodies go underground. Grade and orebody shape also count. The sentence names the main factors and does not say they are the only ones, so it is true at Grade 5 level.

items.bewering: mynbou: Om minerale en steenkool uit die aarde te haal; ook ontginning genoem.
items.bron: This matches the study block; same sources (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining; https://en.wiktionary.com/wiki/ontginnen).

items.bewering: erts: Gesteente met genoeg van 'n waardevolle mineraal daarin dat dit die moeite werd is om dit te ontgin.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ore (see the study-block item).

items.bewering: mynwerker: Iemand wat in 'n myn werk om erts of steenkool uit te haal.
items.bron: This is the standard meaning (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining).

items.bewering: verwerk: Om iets te verander of te behandel sodat mense dit kan gebruik, soos om erts fyn te maak en die mineraal daaruit te haal.
items.bron: The example matches mineral processing: crushing, then liberation and concentration (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ore).

items.bewering: grondstof: 'n Stof uit die natuur waarvan mense ander dinge maak.
items.bron: This is the standard meaning of 'raw material', a basic material from nature used to make other goods. It is consistent with the mining sources above (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining).

items.bewering: mineraalafsetting: 'n Plek in die aardkors waar baie van 'n mineraal bymekaar lê.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ore: an ore deposit is an 'accumulation of minerals within a host rock'.

items.bewering: myngebied: Die myn en alles wat om die myn lê, soos die aanleg, rotshope, paaie en geboue.
items.bron: The MPRDA 'mining area' definition includes the authorised land, linked roads, and the buildings, structures, machinery, mine dumps and residue stockpiles on it (https://a-mla.org/en/country/law/2222; https://source.acts.co.za/mineral-and-petroleum-resources-development-act-2002/mining_area.php).

items.bewering: aanleg: Geboue en masjiene waar erts verwerk word, dikwels by die myn self.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mining: processing plants with crushers and mills are built during mine development. Black Mountain processes its ore on site (https://vedanta-zincinternational.com/what-we-do/our-operations/black-mountain-mining/).

opsomming: Every claim checks out: the definitions of mining, ore and mineral deposit, the order of finding, mining and processing, what makes up a mining area, and the two main mining methods. The lesson has no superlatives and no analogies, and the 'two ways' are not named in this lesson, which is a coverage question, not a fact question.
